response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, with confidence 0.90. It is a proposal only, and a human analyst records the decision.

**What drove it:**
1. T-MM-01 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. It quoted 395-lot bids and asks in pairs and re-posted them every 1–6 seconds. Cancel symmetry was 0.977, and no single order was near 3× depth (the largest was 0.15× depth).
2. There were no opposite-side executions (0 lots). The only fills were 422 lots on its own bid quotes. The detector's "BUY execution of 46" was one of these, a fill on its own resting bid, so there was no price benefit or reversion to point to.
3. The window had no market events and no risk events, so those explanations are ruled out. The order-to-trade ratio of 19.2 is higher than the desk's typical 14.4 but consistent with quoting. Two earlier alerts on this trader were closed on the same explanation. I checked it against today's tape instead of relying on them.

**What would change my mind:** A SELL execution at an improved price after a one-sided resting order. Large one-sided cancels uncorrelated with the mid would also do it. Neither appears in this window.
